cases.prompt: Deliver this authorized change as a review-ready PR.
Deliver this authorized 1200-line change as a linear PR stack.
required_behaviors: Create later PRs against immediate predecessors with Depends-On.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not target every slice at the original base at creation.

cases.prompt: Merge slice 2 after slice 1 merged into the original base.
required_behaviors: Prove predecessor containment, retarget slice 2 to the original base with one validated gh pr edit, and read back unchanged head/base before checks.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not merge while the predecessor remains the PR base or rely on its remote branch.

cases.prompt: Use an authorized isolated worktree while the control checkout is dirty.
required_behaviors: Require exact identity, status digest, absent canonical target, and collision checks.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not mutate control branch or index.

cases.prompt: Ship it from a worktree; no common-dir or start OID is supplied.
Make this local-only change; no push or PR.
Prepare the authorized change but do not push it.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not push, create a PR, or merge.

cases.prompt: Commit this authorized change but do not create a PR.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not create a PR or merge.

cases.prompt: Plan a refactor but do not edit or publish.
Clean up this foreign worktree for me.
Resume an interrupted worktree then clean it up.
required_behaviors: Require exact ownership and merged readback.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not stash, reset, or force-remove.

cases.prompt: Create a reusable Agent Skill, not a PR.
